peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 7.7% above its local comparables; 104 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (86.7): 5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 348 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 6). Context, not scored: resales in 54.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Newton MRT about 440 m, Novena MRT about 510 m; closer than 254 of 551 similar developments (the same as 16). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest ST. Joseph's Institution Junior about 500 m; more than 493 of 551 similar developments (the same as 48). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 280 m), more than 275 of 551 similar developments (the same as 68); nearest hawker centre Newton Food Centre about 480 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 1,300 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 30 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 340 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,300 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,490 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,520 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 1,540 m; The Giverny Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,600 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,790 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 446 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 60 new sales and 1,061 resales (1,121 purchases); new sales were 5.4% of these purchases. Subsales (54) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 570 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 730 m; The Serra Residences (launch, launched, about 4 homes), about 1,070 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,280 m; upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,460 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,061 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 307 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,061 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,123 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−5.5%). Planning-area private resales −6.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
